name: Aura Cleaving Weapon
description:
You have improved your golem's offense by allowing it to energize its weapon to punch through auras.
Your golem's natural attacks deal an extra damage die against auras.

name: Ballista
description:
You mounted a ballista on your golem, giving it a ranged weapon.
Your golem has a ranged attack (DEX + trained), 1d10 + PHY piercing damage, with the Reload 1 trait and a range of 10 tiles.
While adjacent to your golem you may use your DEX instead of its own DEX for the attack.

name: Elemental Ward
description:
With the right runes and spellwork your golem is now resistant to elemental damage.
Your golem has resistance 3 to elemental damage.

name: Feathersteel Wings
description:
You've equipped your golem with feathersteel wings that let it glide down and perform acrobatic maneuvers.
Your golem has a 4-tile glide speed (while it's Medium or smaller).
Your golem is trained in Acrobatics and Stealth.

name: Golem Mount
description:
You design your golem to serve as a suitable mount.
You can mount your golem as 1 action.
You have a +2 bonus to Reflex saves against strikes and targeted attacks while mounted on your golem.

name: Integrated Weapon
description:
You've designed your golem to allow it to integrate a weapon into one of its arms.
You can spend a minute to attach a weapon to the golem.
While attached it cannot be disarmed and has a +1 bonus to attack rolls.

name: Programmed Tactics
description:
You program in two tactical maneuvers for your golem.
Your golem learns two basic techniques.
This upgrade can be taken multiple times, choosing new techniques.

name: Raise Guard
description:
Your golem can raise its hands or appendages to guard itself.
Your golem's natural strikes have the Block 2 trait, giving it an option to defend itself.
It also learns the Protect Ally action.

name: Soul Link
description:
You set up a crystal connection to connect the golem to your soul, giving you a few benefits.
You can see and hear from your golem's location.
You can command your golem without verbal commands, and the range of your commands is now 20 tiles.
You can recharge Capacitor Upgrades within that range.
prerequisites: Trained in Souls Lore or Expert in Arcana

name: Specialized Armory
description:
You program in specialized weapon training into your golem.
Your golem becomes trained in two weapon groups.
You may choose an Advanced Weapon instead of a weapon group.

name: Defense Protocol
description:
You've set up your golem to provide great defense to you and your allies.
After your golem uses the Block or Parry action, adjacent allies have +1 to all saving throws until the start of the next turn.
Additionally, you may Take Cover behind your golem as part of it taking the Block action.

name: Fire Capacitor
description:
You install a flame throwing projector in your golem.
Your golem gets the Fire Capacitor action.
After use, you must then recharge the capacitor with 5 mana as an action while adjacent to your golem.

name: Frost Capacitor
description:
You install a chilling projector in your golem.
Your golem gets the Frost Capacitor action.
After use, you must then recharge the capacitor with 5 mana as an action while adjacent to your golem.

name: Lightning Capacitor
description:
You install a lightning projecting device into your golem.
Your golem gets the Lightning Capacitor action.
After use, you must then recharge the capacitor with 5 mana as an action while adjacent to your golem.

name: Project Aura
description:
You can project your Aura to protect your golem from dangerous attacks.
When your golem would take damage, you can use Aura Block as a reaction as long as you are within 20 tiles of it.

name: Reinforced Armor
description:
You have improved the defenses of your golem, making it even tougher.
Increase its resistance to physical damage by 2.
Its health increases by an amount equal to its PHY.

name: Sentry Protocol
description:
You set up a polished lens to allow your golem to watch as if it were an alert sentry.
Your golem becomes trained in Perception and can use your INT modifier for Perception.
When your golem detects a threat you are alerted, as long as it is within Soul Link range.

name: Size-Up Golem
description:
You've sized up your golem.
Your golem is Large.
Its health is (4 × your level) + your INT + its PHY.

name: Swift Golem
description:
Swiftness isn't what many expect when it comes to golems.
Your golem's speeds increase by 1.

name: Soul Channel Spell
description:
Using your Soul Link you can now channel spells through your golem.
When casting spells you may choose to cast them as if you were in your golem's space.
This gives the spell the Complex trait.
You cannot cast spells that already have the Complex trait with this upgrade.

name: Tail Strike
description:
A tail or tentacle is an unorthodox weapon for a golem, but it can hit foes that aren't expecting it.
Your golem has a Tail natural weapon with a reach of 2. It does 1d8 damage.
When you design your golem you choose whether it's an Agile tail or a Shoving tail.
An Agile tail also has the Agile and Finesse traits and does slashing damage.
A Sweeping tail also has the Shove and Sweep traits and does bludgeoning damage.

name: Upgraded Components
description:
With some upgraded components, your golem is now stronger or faster than before.
Increase your golem's PHY or DEX by 1. 
You may choose this upgrade multiple times.

name: Advanced Programmed Tactics
description:
You've programmed in more advanced maneuvers
Your golem learns two advanced techniques.
This upgrade can be taken multiple times, choosing new techniques.

name: Battlefield Stomp
description:
Your golems size allows its to create a thundering stomp.
Your golem gets the Battlefield Stomp action.

name: Greater Elemental Ward
description:
Stronger wards have improved your golem's resistance to magic.
Increase your golem's resistance to elemental damage by 6.

name: Capacitor Upcharge
description:
You have upgraded your golem's capacitors, allowing you to channel more mana into destructive magic.
When using a capacitor action you may overcharge it, increasing the damage and size.
If you do, your golem becomes Stunned 1 and needs 15 mana before the capacitor can be recharged.
Fire Capacitor: 8d6 damage, 7-tile cone.
Lightning Capacitor: 5d12 damage, 2-tile-wide, 12-tile-long line.
Frost Capacitor: 7d4 damage, 5-tile cone. The Frozen condition works on Large creatures.

name: Perfected Spell Channeling
description:
You've set up a perfected resonating link to channel your spells.
When channeling spells through your golem you no longer give the spells the Complex trait, and you can cast Complex spells.
You can also target your golem with spells that would normally only target you.

name: War Walker
description:
You've built your golem as a true war walker, a machine of battlefield prowess.
Your golem is Huge.
Its health is (5 × your level) + your INT + its PHY.
It does an extra die of damage with its attacks.

name: Calculating Golem
description:
You've improved your golem's runic circuits to give it greater intelligence.
Increase your golem's INT by 1.
Your golem learns two complex techniques.

name: Winged Golem
description:
You've improved your golem's wings and given it magical propulsion.
Your golem has a 5-tile flight speed (while it's Medium or smaller).
